nonblocking_cost_observation.scope: A concrete repeated type-index construction cost exists after moving to the complete source set. No duration, timeout cause or 600-second outcome is inferred. Existing verifier cache could be reused only for proven identical type indices (baseline, pure function injection, expected-only row change); duplicate real source needs its own cache. Reported to the sole QA author, not modified here.
nonblocking_cost_observation.author_disposition: Sole QA author confirms this draft remains unchanged: Root approved only the full collector and ignored-argument migration, with no new cache; original 600-second source-closure budget stays. No cache or optional test was added.

limits: No test method, protected validator, caller validator, extractor main, H/native process, Cargo or formatter was executed. Only bytes/hash, Python AST/diff and production-source reading were used.
The 49-row final protection proposal and 18 new attacks are not included in this partial draft. Their completeness and actual outcomes remain pending.

Source-level mutation guards do not prove real authenticated primary-Eligible/retention-Ineligible behavior, task authorization, independent operational evaluation, complete costs, deployment or cold recovery.
A source-fence rejection is not evidence of objective fraud and is not a fabricated NoUpdate or comparison verdict.
